judgment.notes: M008 is instantiated on the Borel real line with λ and the global inequality ind(I,c)≤Σ_i f_i from F003; outside I every summand is zero. M007 applies first to I using N005's measurability and λ(I)=1, then to each J_i∩I using F002, with legitimate finite nonnegative coefficients. M006 has countable index ℕ and the λ-a.e.-measurability proved in S003 (routine implication verified in BG003); it requires no finite integral. N005 is applied only to nonempty B_i, finite nonnegative bound ρ_i and positive η_i; all are established before use. No E applications occur.

The squared Euclidean distance formula and nonnegative distances give coordinate distance contraction, hence the diameter bounds. At each t∈I, selecting A_i when t∈J_i gives a δ-cover of E; the content infimum and positive-exponent power monotonicity (BG001) yield the pointwise cost inequality. The Borel interval enlargement is justified by N005; η_i>0 with denominator ≥1, including ρ_i=0 (BG002). S003 proves indicator measurability by inverse images without asserting measurability of the arbitrary covering projections. The three supplied integral results then give the stated cost bound; BG004–BG007 verify routine power and series details, including infinite series. For finite total cost, if c exceeded it then ε=(c−cost)/2 contradicts F004; infinite cost is immediate. The lower-bound direction for the final infimum is correct. Empty sets, empty padding and zero diameters are harmless (BG006); no assumption on s other than positivity is used.

Every direct input has an actual role: N002 gives finite c (and the Euclidean product identification), N005 gives interval enlargement, Borel sets and λ(I)=1, N001 gives the nonnegative-series convention and geometric sum, M008 integrates the pointwise inequality, M006 interchanges the nonnegative sum and integral, and M007 evaluates both kinds of indicator integrals. The word 'Tonelli' in S004 describes the already supplied M006, not a further imported theorem. Six probed basic-library power/measurability facts and one elementary finite-sum completion are recorded as BG001–BG007. No additional project lemma or original H is used.
